profile.bio: I bring guides to your soul, the place where you feel supported, uplifted, heard, and remember your true beauty and worth✨👻

posts.name: You who are leaning on things and in oth…
posts.text:
You who are leaning on things and in other people, including on idols thinking that's what gives you strength, when in fact the strength comes from within and because you don't know this, think that these things, this idols give you strength and are what keep you standing but in reality, these things are only keeping you disconnected from yourself, taking advantage of your pain, making money off of it and keeping you blind to the truth, while you are living a wasted life on something worthless to the soul especially when you've been on it for a long time, meaning you've had enough experience, draining you while you don't know that all you need is yourself, while your soul is calling "I want to live, to live what uplifts me, what makes me feel good, what motivates me, I don't want to miss this chance to go back home" 

The soul has been rejected, ignored, and despised when in fact it is our truth, not living our truth is not valuing ourselves. The soul has been rejected, ignored, and despised when in fact it is our truth; not living our truth is not valuing ourselves.

I know this because I lived like that a long time ago, and thank God I freed myself from it and I freed myself before I found that channel

https://youtube.com/@vitalfrosi?si=Iz4lbHlBWq4UyRzl 👈 Link to the channel I'm mentioning

So I am spreading this channel because it can bring as many souls as possible back to their true essence, as long as each person has the willpower and attitude to do so because only ourselves can free ourselves, there are guides but it is we who choose whether to follow them or not, we are the ones who decide our destiny.

I am revealing the truth so that you can get out of this precipice that are walking towards without even realizing it.
